'''annakinstarkiller Ralltiir Operations''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[annakinstarkiller]]
* '''Published:''' 19 January 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor: Dense Forest|Endor-D-endordenseforest.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Endor: Dense Forest
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 Endor Dense Forest annakinstarkil.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

I don't know how this deck will fair at a tournament but it has worked well for me. This deck is intended to overwhelm the opponent with a large deployment of characters.

The published list has 57 cards.

== Strategy ==

If played right this deck can easily overwhelm your opponent. There are plenty of characters and with RO/ITHOTE you can pull out Elite Stormtrooper or a site. Once you have down all your sites you can concentrate on controlling them with your characters. I guarantee you will get at least 2 characters in your starting hand. Once deployed there are several cards that can help you protect them. Elite trooper is power +2 with a blaster and each is ability 2 so if you have to down there is already enough to draw battle destiny. Blasters make them more powerful. Use Trooper Assault for an even better attack. For those pesky SAC decks there is Dark Forces and if you encounter a pilot you don't like, tell him He Is Not Ready. If you get swarmed yourself use Collateral Damage and Sacrifice to minimize some of your damage. If you overwhelm them on the ground try You Overestimate Their Chances and in space use Overwhelmed. The <>Forest will protect your characters and once you flip RO/ITHOTE it's a breeze.
